posts.title: Let’s-Make-a-Splash-Together!
posts.description: We’re thrilled to invite you to enjoy unforgettable moments in our new beach area! This vibrant space allows cruisers to experience a beach day right at the port, complete with board games, lounge chairs, and, of course, the excitement of Splash Surfing.
posts.content:
We’re thrilled to invite you to enjoy unforgettable moments in our new beach area! This vibrant space allows cruisers to experience a beach day right at the port, complete with board games, lounge chairs, and, of course, the excitement of Splash Surfing.

Splash Surfing is our wave simulator, where kids and adults can test their surfing skills and enjoy the rush. It’s the perfect way to add some thrill to your day at the harbor!

We can’t wait to share this amazing experience with you. Don't forget to capture the fun and tag us in your photos—let’s relive those memories together!

posts.title: Pride-celebration-at-Taino-Bay
posts.description: June was a fantastic month! Throughout June, we commemorated Pride Month with events, and activities that celebrate the community.
posts.content:
June was a fantastic month! Throughout June, we commemorated Pride Month with events, and activities that celebrate the community. Diversity, equity, and acceptance are values that drive our commitment to creating a welcoming environment. It is a must for us to foster a space where both employees and visitors feel valued, respected, and happy.

We had a great time celebrating with you!

posts.title: Icekery-is-OPEN!
posts.description: Last May 15, we had a blast, enjoyin delicious ice cream at the brand new Icekery at the port. This fun ice cream shop offer a delicious artisanal ice cream variety for those who want to beat the Dominican heat.
posts.content:
Last May 15, we had a blast, enjoyin delicious ice cream at the brand new Icekery at the port. This fun ice cream shop offer a delicious artisanal ice cream variety for those who want to beat the Dominican heat.

You can custom your ice cream by choosing your favorite toppings. From gummy bears, to chocolate sticks, and cookies, you can make it as yummy as you wish.

Icekery is easy to find upon arrival...It is right in front of Monkey Island!

So here you have it. After enjoying a day filled with adventure, visit Icekery and freshen up before heading back to your cruise!
